criterion_text: — Discoverable work context without false freshness: `nession_agent_list_sessions` exposes bounded title/tag summary alongside existing live tmux facts and stable `session_id`/instance identity, while full description is returned only on Get; empty legacy context and failed/stale metadata lookup remain distinguishable. The staging Project `project_id` known/unknown/null semantics remain unchanged; read-only listing does not create/write Metadata or silently infer a task from foreground command/cwd.

verifiers.summary: Session lists expose bounded, mode-independent work-context summaries

evidence.value: nession-mcp at exact SHA 2796eceb717e4508681c3a8ea21172ecf3ed7e45: all four hosting modes listed the saved Session with the same title/tags/revision summary and no description, listed a no-metadata Session as available revision 0, and kept the Project projection intact

verifiers.summary: Summary availability is explicit and the Project projection is unchanged

evidence.value: nession-mcp at exact SHA 2796eceb717e4508681c3a8ea21172ecf3ed7e45: a confirmed-empty summary serialized state=available revision 0 while a failed lookup serialized state=unavailable with no fabricated summary, the projection never contained description, and the Server projection still distinguished a confirmed non-association from unresolved metadata

verifiers.summary: List summaries are read-only, identity-keyed and truthfully unavailable on failure

evidence.value: nession-agent at exact SHA 2796eceb717e4508681c3a8ea21172ecf3ed7e45: the list summary was read by instance identity without initializing tmux state or metadata, no identity meant a confirmed revision-0 record, and an invalid/unreadable identity became unavailable
